title: communication ritual
goal: P7.1 Restate → brute force → optimise → code → test → complexity, out loud

tasks.do: Restate every problem in your own words before writing anything
State the brute force and its complexity before optimising
Narrate decisions and trade-offs, not syntax
Keep silences under thirty seconds, or say what you are weighing
Ask about size, ranges, duplicates, nulls, and empty input
Dry-run a small input and name the edge cases before being asked
Give both time and space complexity, with justification
Take hints as help and say what changes because of them
8 STAR stories written, two minutes each, each with a number in the result
4 system design stories drawable cold, with one defended trade-off each
One recorded solve reviewed this week, silences counted
One mock interview completed this week
Gap list written within an hour of the last real interview, top item drilled the next day
